_README: Coatings feedstock-margin model config. The margin-pressure index is a weighted basket of the PETROLEUM- AND ENERGY-LINKED portion of a coatings bill of materials (BOM), each input mapped to the best available tradeable/official proxy. Components with no data on a given run (e.g. EIA propane before an EIA_API_KEY is set) are simply dropped and the remaining weights renormalize. See spreads.py COATINGS_BOM for the full value-chain documentation and the explicit TiO2 data gap.
_alert_doc: Index >= alert_threshold raises an alert (briefing flag + optional one-per-day email). 70 ~ +1 sigma of broad feedstock cost pressure.

propane_mont_belvieu_usd_gal.label: Propane (Mont Belvieu)
propane_mont_belvieu_usd_gal.proxy_for: Propylene / acrylic & epoxy resin feedstock (PDH route)

brent_crude_usd_bbl.label: Brent crude
brent_crude_usd_bbl.proxy_for: Base petroleum linkage across the chain

eur_usd.label: EUR/USD
eur_usd.proxy_for: FX cost for EU producers buying USD-priced feedstock

crack_spreads._doc: Refining margins computed from product vs crude futures (1 bbl = 42 gal). These are context/validation signals, not index inputs — they show where margin sits in the refining chain that feeds petrochemicals.

backtest._doc: Validates the margin-pressure index against an independent ground truth (FRED coatings PPI). Needs the FRED series backfilled (python -m feedstock.backfill) and enough index history. target_metric must match a FRED series name in sources.fred.series.

eia._doc: EIA v2 /seriesid route. Needs free EIA_API_KEY (api.eia.gov). Series IDs are configurable so you can fix any facet without code changes.

fred._doc: FRED observations API. Needs free FRED_API_KEY. coatings_ppi is the real backtest validation target (PPI: Paint & Coating Manufacturing).
